# E6-4 operational diagnostics

These are descriptive reuse of authenticated E6-3A corrected traces; E6-4 adds no reader or serving request.

- Corrected boundary: synchronized native selector scoring; candidate lookup and persistence excluded.
- Retrieval and downstream reader are excluded.
- Failed attempts remain failures; successful-request p95 is not a full reliability SLO.
- Forward counts remain observed/derived only where the historical adapter exposed the contract; unobserved counts are not set to zero.
- E6-3A Amos SciFact context failures remain 56/200 (28%) under full content.
